addressed.change: Validate amount decimals via exponent (as_tuple().exponent >= -2) instead of quantize comparison, so trailing-zero 3dp like '10.000' is rejected and large values don't raise InvalidOperation; quantize outputs under enlarged localcontext precision
Same exponent check rejects '10.000' as having 3 decimal places even though numerically equal to 2dp

claims.title: Valid large amount crashes during quantization instead of being grouped
Amount with 3 decimal places is accepted when the third digit is zero

addressed.change: Fixed _quantize_2dp precision to account for exponent shift (len(digits)+max(0,exp+2)+10) so large values like 1E+30 quantize to 2dp without InvalidOperation.

claims.title: Large amount in scientific notation crashes quantization instead of returning a 2dp group amount
